title: mine-flow — STEP-54.9–54.10a Findings Ledger Slice
scope: Every FC-54.* finding in STEP-54.9, STEP-54.10, and STEP-54.10a.
purpose: Verified JSON input slice for STEP-54.11 consolidation; not the final master spec or STEP close.

FC-54.9-001.summary: The list page opens Upload and Detail pages via `Navigator.push(MaterialPageRoute(...))` rather than GoRouter named routes, even though `/tools/data-bucket/upload` and `/:id` exist.
FC-54.9-001.source_summary: The list page opens Upload and Detail pages via `Navigator.push(MaterialPageRoute(...))` rather than GoRouter named routes, even though `/tools/data-bucket/upload` and `/:id` exist. Breaks URL synchronization.
FC-54.9-001.evidence_status: `data_bucket_list_page.dart:320-334`, `367-379` Citation re-resolution: Pass — list still uses MaterialPageRoute at 320–334 and 367–379 while named child routes exist at router.dart:183–215.
FC-54.9-001.required_treatment: STEP-55 must migrate these to `context.push` or `context.go` to utilize GoRouter paths and support D5.

FC-54.9-002.area: Data Bucket: D1/D2 Sheet Modality & D4 Interception
FC-54.9-002.summary: The Upload form is a full-page push (`FScaffold` on mobile, no header on desktop) without a `PopScope`.
FC-54.9-002.source_summary: The Upload form is a full-page push (`FScaffold` on mobile, no header on desktop) without a `PopScope`. Selecting a large file and accidentally pressing Back discards the file silently without dirty interception.
FC-54.9-002.evidence_status: `upload_file_page.dart:73`, `310-336` Citation re-resolution: Pass — upload remains a full FScaffold at 310–336; no PopScope is present in the file.
FC-54.9-002.required_treatment: STEP-55 must migrate Upload to a modal side-sheet (desktop) / bottom-sheet (mobile) with explicit `PopScope` dirty interception.

FC-54.9-003.summary: Upload progress exists, but the back action is disabled during upload and no explicit cancellation action is available.
FC-54.9-003.source_summary: Upload progress is shown, but there is no cancellation affordance (the back button is disabled during upload: `isUploading ? null : Navigator.pop`).
FC-54.9-003.evidence_status: `upload_file_page.dart:328` Citation re-resolution: Pass — upload back action remains disabled while uploading at 326–330; no cancel action is exposed.
FC-54.9-003.required_treatment: Provide an explicit cancel action for the upload state, especially crucial for large geospatial files.

FC-54.9-004.summary: Upload errors display a toast with a "Coba Lagi" action that retries `_submitUpload()` without requiring the user to re-select the file, as `_fileBytes` is preserved in state.
FC-54.9-004.source_summary: Upload errors display a toast with a "Coba Lagi" action that retries `_submitUpload()` without requiring the user to re-select the file, as `_fileBytes` is preserved in state.
FC-54.9-004.required_treatment: Maintain this recovery pattern when migrating to sheet adapter. (Silent failure on connectivity drop / app close remains an unverified data-trust edge case).

FC-54.9-005.summary: Enforces a `_kMaxFileSizeBytes` check before reading into memory, and displays a formatted size under the selected file icon prior to commit.
FC-54.9-005.source_summary: Enforces a `_kMaxFileSizeBytes` check before reading into memory, and displays a formatted size under the selected file icon prior to commit.

FC-54.9-006.summary: List → Form/Detail → Back loops properly execute a `RefreshFiles()` event upon returning, avoiding stale data.
FC-54.9-006.source_summary: List → Form/Detail → Back loops properly execute a `RefreshFiles()` event upon returning, avoiding stale data.
FC-54.9-006.required_treatment: Ensure `RefreshFiles` behavior is preserved when shifting to GoRouter.

FC-54.9-007.summary: Timeline exposes only a date-range selector and milestone cards.
FC-54.9-007.source_summary: Timeline exposes only a date-range selector and milestone cards. There are no fake CRUD affordances or missing milestone entry forms that should exist—it acts explicitly as a read-mostly viewing surface.
FC-54.9-007.required_treatment: Preserve read-only intent for this release; milestone entry sheet remains deliberately excluded.

FC-54.9-008.summary: Deliberate absence of a report action in both Data Bucket (documented as "no meaningful report type") and Work Timeline.
FC-54.9-008.source_summary: Deliberate absence of a report action in both Data Bucket (documented as "no meaningful report type") and Work Timeline.
FC-54.9-008.required_treatment: Maintain absence as a deliberate design decision.

FC-54.9-009.summary: Both features utilize `FTheme` tokens (no raw colors found) and rely on a transparent `Material` wrapper for `PopupMenuButton` interoperability, but `DataBucketListPage` still uses a Material `FloatingActionButton.extended` for the upload action, `UploadFilePage` uses Material `showDatePicker` and `InputDecorator` for the acquisition date field, and `MilestoneCard` uses `InkWell` instead of `FTappable`.
FC-54.9-009.source_summary: Both features utilize `FTheme` tokens (no raw colors found) and rely on a transparent `Material` wrapper for `PopupMenuButton` interoperability, but `DataBucketListPage` still uses a Material `FloatingActionButton.extended` for the upload action, `UploadFilePage` uses Material `showDatePicker` and `InputDecorator` for the acquisition date field, and `MilestoneCard` uses `InkWell` instead of `FTappable`. These violate the 54.1 token conformance rubric to use ForUI components.
FC-54.9-009.required_treatment: STEP-55 must replace the Material FAB with a floating `FButton`, migrate the date picker field and InkWell to ForUI equivalents (or document an explicit interoperability exception).

FC-54.9-010.summary: Keyboard focus and a11y contrast remain untested at runtime.
FC-54.9-010.source_summary: Keyboard focus and a11y contrast remain untested at runtime.
FC-54.9-010.required_treatment: Validate keyboard traversal and contrast ratios during runtime audit.

FC-54.10-001.summary: The four stat cards display KPI values but have no tap/navigation action.
FC-54.10-001.source_summary: The four stat cards display KPI values but have no tap/navigation action. The class comment says the page provides "shortcuts that push on top of the shell" for Reports, Timeline, and Notifications, but no tap-through is implemented — `_StatCard.build` returns `SizedBox > Semantics > FCard` with no `GestureDetector` or `FTappable`.
FC-54.10-001.evidence_status: `dashboard_page.dart:143-231` Citation re-resolution: Pass — _StatCard remains presentation-only at 143–231 with no action callback.
FC-54.10-001.required_treatment: STEP-55 must wire each stat card to its respective feature: Kru Aktif → `/teams/attendance`, Volume → `/operations/cut-fill`, Pemeriksaan Alat → `/teams/equipment-check`, Notifikasi → `/notifications`.

FC-54.10-002.area: Dashboard: KPI set missing five features
FC-54.10-002.summary: Only four KPIs are aggregated (Attendance, CutFill, EquipmentCheck, Notifications).
FC-54.10-002.source_summary: Only four KPIs are aggregated (Attendance, CutFill, EquipmentCheck, Notifications). Land Clearing, Inventory, Daily Log, Benchmark DB, and Data Bucket have no dashboard presence.
FC-54.10-002.evidence_status: `dashboard_cubit.dart:3-7, 50-55`; `dashboard_state.dart:10-13` Citation re-resolution: Pass — DashboardCubit still fetches exactly four sources at 49–55 and emits four KPI fields at 57–64.
FC-54.10-002.required_treatment: STEP-55 should decide (with the user) whether to extend the KPI set or explicitly document the four cards as intentionally scoped.

FC-54.10-003.area: Dashboard: Error state undifferentiated from loading
FC-54.10-003.summary: `DashboardStatus.failure` produces value `'-'` — identical to the loading skeleton.
FC-54.10-003.source_summary: `DashboardStatus.failure` produces value `'-'` — identical to the loading skeleton. The `isFailure` subtitle `'Gagal memuat'` is easily missed below the large `'-'` glyph.
FC-54.10-003.evidence_status: `dashboard_page.dart:60-93` Citation re-resolution: Pass — failure still uses the same '-' value path as loading at dashboard_page.dart:56–93.
FC-54.10-003.required_treatment: STEP-55: loading → spinner, failure → error icon + subtitle + retry action.

FC-54.10-004.summary: `loadDashboardStats` is called once at route build.
FC-54.10-004.source_summary: `loadDashboardStats` is called once at route build. No pull-to-refresh, no timer, no BLoC reload event. KPIs go stale mid-session.
FC-54.10-004.required_treatment: STEP-55 should add pull-to-refresh or a scheduled refresh interval.

FC-54.10-005.summary: After first boot, a user with no data sees `0` for all KPIs — indistinguishable from a day with genuine zero activity.
FC-54.10-005.source_summary: After first boot, a user with no data sees `0` for all KPIs — indistinguishable from a day with genuine zero activity. `DashboardStatus.initial` and `loading` are conflated; no first-use nudge exists.
FC-54.10-005.evidence_status: `dashboard_page.dart:56-58` Citation re-resolution: Pass — initial/loading remain conflated at 56–58 and success zero has no first-use branch.
FC-54.10-005.required_treatment: STEP-55 should distinguish first-run zero-data; add a call-to-action card directing the user to enter their first record.

FC-54.10-006.summary: Notifications are only reachable through the mobile header on Dashboard; the persistent five-tab bar has no Notifications entry.
FC-54.10-006.source_summary: The bell icon lives in `_NotificationIconButton` inside `GlobalAppHeader`. On mobile, `GlobalAppHeader` is rendered only when path == `/` (dashboard). On any other shell route the header disappears. The five bottom-bar tabs include no Notifications item.
FC-54.10-006.evidence_status: `app_shell.dart:397-398`; `global_app_header.dart:333-345`; `app_shell.dart:47-57` Citation re-resolution: Pass — mobile header remains dashboard-only at app_shell.dart:397–398 and the five tabs remain 47–57.
FC-54.10-006.required_treatment: STEP-55 must provide a persistent notification entry on mobile (persistent header bell, Dashboard tab badge, or Teams group landing tile).

FC-54.10-007.summary: All three states covered: `FCircularProgress` (loading), icon+label (empty), semantic error container (error).
FC-54.10-007.source_summary: All three states covered: `FCircularProgress` (loading), icon+label (empty), semantic error container (error). Staggered entrance honors `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf`.

FC-54.10-008.summary: `GestureDetector.onTap` marks as read; `FButton.icon` per card dismisses; "Tutup Semua" batch-dismisses.
FC-54.10-008.source_summary: `GestureDetector.onTap` marks as read; `FButton.icon` per card dismisses; "Tutup Semua" batch-dismisses. Semantic labels differentiate read vs unread.

FC-54.10-009.area: Notification center: No unread badge on entry icon
FC-54.10-009.summary: Desktop bell icon renders bare `LucideIcons.inbox` with no count badge.
FC-54.10-009.source_summary: Desktop bell icon renders bare `LucideIcons.inbox` with no count badge. Users on non-dashboard routes have no glanceable unread indicator.
FC-54.10-009.required_treatment: STEP-55 should add a badge overlay when `unreadCount > 0`.

FC-54.10-010.summary: Notification card tap area uses `GestureDetector` (Material-adjacent primitive).
FC-54.10-010.source_summary: Notification card tap area uses `GestureDetector` (Material-adjacent primitive). Token conformance requires `FTappable` where a ForUI equivalent exists. Hit-target at 48dp is unverified.
FC-54.10-010.required_treatment: STEP-55 should migrate tap region to `FTappable` and verify 48dp minimum touch height.

FC-54.10-011.area: Notification center: Warning mapped to `secondary` token
FC-54.10-011.summary: `NotificationSeverity.warning` maps to `theme.colors.secondary` — a muted neutral on the Zinc palette, not a warning amber.
FC-54.10-011.source_summary: `NotificationSeverity.warning` maps to `theme.colors.secondary` — a muted neutral on the Zinc palette, not a warning amber. Severity differentiation is undercut visually.
FC-54.10-011.required_treatment: STEP-55 should use a dedicated warning token or document an explicit exception if none exists in ForUI.

FC-54.10-012.area: Settings: Profile is read-only, no edit flow
FC-54.10-012.summary: `_ProfileCard` displays name and role as plain `Text` with no edit affordance.
FC-54.10-012.source_summary: `_ProfileCard` displays name and role as plain `Text` with no edit affordance. The rubric's lifecycle-cohesion dimension and the prompt scope clause both flag this.
FC-54.10-012.evidence_status: `settings_page.dart:408-453` Citation re-resolution: Pass — profile remains display-only at settings_page.dart:408–453.
FC-54.10-012.required_treatment: STEP-55 should add a profile-edit sheet aligned with D1/D2. For this release, display name is the likely editable field; role is server-managed.

FC-54.10-013.area: Settings: Theme toggle — all three modes
FC-54.10-013.summary: Light, Dark, System modes all present and wired to `SettingsCubit.updateThemeMode` via `_ThemeOption`.
FC-54.10-013.source_summary: Light, Dark, System modes all present and wired to `SettingsCubit.updateThemeMode` via `_ThemeOption`. Selected variant renders as `primary`; unselected as `outline`.

FC-54.10-014.summary: English/Indonesian toggle wired to `SettingsCubit.updateLocale`; partial-translation caveat disclosed in UI copy per RISK-0004.
FC-54.10-014.source_summary: English/Indonesian toggle wired to `SettingsCubit.updateLocale`; partial-translation caveat disclosed in UI copy per RISK-0004.
FC-54.10-014.required_treatment: Runtime locale-switch effect (which strings actually update) is `Unverified` — STEP-55 should run a live test.

FC-54.10-015.area: Settings: Logout dialog uses FAlert inside FDialog
FC-54.10-015.summary: `showFDialog > FDialog > FAlert` doubles the container chrome — `FDialog` provides background/border; `FAlert` adds another border-left, icon, and text layout.
FC-54.10-015.source_summary: `showFDialog > FDialog > FAlert` doubles the container chrome — `FDialog` provides background/border; `FAlert` adds another border-left, icon, and text layout. Visually heavy for a simple confirmation.
FC-54.10-015.required_treatment: STEP-55 should migrate to a plain `FDialog` with inline `Text` title and subtitle, matching the D4 dirty-intercept dialog pattern.

FC-54.10-016.summary: Support email and WhatsApp number are hardcoded in source, not environment-configurable.
FC-54.10-016.source_summary: Support email and WhatsApp number are hardcoded in source, not environment-configurable. They will differ across staging and production.
FC-54.10-016.required_treatment: STEP-55 should move contact details to `AppConstants` or `.env`-sourced config.

FC-54.10-017.summary: `_ProfileCard` uses `CircleAvatar` (Material); `FAvatar` is the ForUI equivalent as of forui 0.24.x+.
FC-54.10-017.source_summary: `_ProfileCard` uses `CircleAvatar` (Material); `FAvatar` is the ForUI equivalent as of forui 0.24.x+. The file's own comment acknowledges the Material import but `FAvatar` is now available.
FC-54.10-017.required_treatment: STEP-55 should replace `CircleAvatar` with `FAvatar` and remove the `flutter/material.dart` import if no other Material primitive remains.

FC-54.10-018.summary: Privacy notice/first-use consent is absent statically; this is a pre-release compliance gate.
FC-54.10-018.source_summary: The In-app Privacy Notice is confirmed absent. Full grep of `lib/features/auth/` for `privacy`, `privasi`, `kebijakan`, `terms`, `ketentuan` returns zero matches. `LoginPage` renders branding, email field, password field, submit button — no notice link, no consent checkbox, no first-use dialog. This confirms RISK-0011's assessment as of the current branch head. Per Doc 17 §3 and UU PDP lawful-basis posture, users must be informed before first use. Pre-release gate per `risks.yml:RISK-0011:revisit_trigger`.
FC-54.10-018.required_treatment: Escalating to user: this is a pre-release gate. STEP-55 must implement a first-login consent flow (modal `FDialog` or dedicated screen) displaying the privacy notice with an explicit acknowledgement action, gating dashboard access. Notice content requires a product/legal decision.
FC-54.10-018.candidate_step_55_account: 55.10 pre-release privacy-consent gate; content requires product/legal approval.

FC-54.10-019.area: Login: No keyboard submit on password field
FC-54.10-019.source_summary: `FTextField.password` has no `textInputAction: TextInputAction.done` or `onSubmitted` callback. Mobile users must lift off the keyboard to tap "Masuk" instead of pressing the keyboard's submit key.
FC-54.10-019.required_treatment: STEP-55 should add `textInputAction: TextInputAction.done` and wire `onSubmitted: (_) => _login(cubit)` on the password field.

FC-54.10-020.area: Login: Error banner has no dismiss
FC-54.10-020.summary: Auth error banner persists until the next login attempt; no dismiss icon, no auto-clear on next keystroke.
FC-54.10-020.source_summary: Auth error banner persists until the next login attempt; no dismiss icon, no auto-clear on next keystroke. A user who mistyped their email sees a persistent red banner they cannot clear.
FC-54.10-020.required_treatment: STEP-55 should auto-dismiss on next field edit or provide an explicit dismiss icon, consistent with the app's toast pattern.

FC-54.10-021.summary: The page has no `Semantics(header: true)` on the `mine-flow` title text and no form-landmark label.
FC-54.10-021.source_summary: The page has no `Semantics(header: true)` on the `mine-flow` title text and no form-landmark label. Screen readers have no clear page-title announcement or form region.
FC-54.10-021.required_treatment: STEP-55 should add `Semantics(header: true)` on the page title and a form-landmark label.

FC-54.10-022.area: Settings: Logout flow — session terminated before route change
FC-54.10-022.source_summary: `AuthCubit.signOut()` is awaited before `context.go(AppRoutes.login)` (CF-004 compliance). Confirmation dialog prevents accidental sign-out on shared field devices.
FC-54.10-022.required_treatment: Preserve. See FC-54.10-015 for dialog presentation polish.

FC-54.10-023.source_summary: WCAG contrast, 48dp targets, focus traversal, text scaling, and dark-mode correctness cannot be verified statically. Semantic labels are present on stat cards and notification cards; login form lacks a page-title landmark (FC-54.10-021).

FC-54.10-024.source_summary: All four surfaces use hardcoded Indonesian/English strings; zero `AppLocalizations` calls found across all four files. Switching the locale to English in Settings will not change any label on these surfaces (static inference). Runtime locale-switch effect is unverified.

FC-54.10a-010.source_summary: In `ThemeMode.system` the app does not re-render when the OS/browser theme changes: emulating `prefers-color-scheme: light` left the frame unchanged (mean RGB stayed dark, artifact bytes ~identical), and `app.dart:44-48` reads `PlatformDispatcher.instance.platformBrightness` inside a `BlocBuilder` that only rebuilds on a `SettingsCubit` emit.
